scripts.build:server: bun build src/server.ts --outfile dist/server/index.js --target bun --format esm
scripts.build:ui: NODE_ENV=production bun build ui/index.tsx --outfile dist/ui/index.js --target browser --format esm --production --external react --external react-dom --external 'react/jsx-runtime' --external styled-components --external '@tanstack/react-query'
scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:ui && cp omni-plugin.json dist/
